responsibility: Coordinates the coherence phase for `rustc_typeck` by wiring coherence queries, running crate-wide coherence checks, and enforcing impl-level restrictions such as forbidden manual impls, marker-trait item bans, and overlap with the automatic `impl Trait for dyn Trait`.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `check/mod.rs` or `astconv/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` operates at crate coherence scope: it registers coherence queries and enforces impl overlap/orphan-style restrictions, rather than performing expression/body type checking or syntax-to-type lowering.
